searchText: Things look calm on the MSF, we're at 100% participation rate now. Performed some consolidations, withdrawals and exits, however some of those things are only valid post epoch 256. Looks broken now. Why no one is panicing? <@412614104222531604> is looking into it so looks like eth1 deposit issue is now kicking in for nimbus/grandine too. As we made a single manual deposit, and I think those clients don't agree on the eth1 deposit queue, and thus stop proposing blocks, but still attest. ``` DBG 2025-04-29 13:16:36.057+00:00 No acceptable eth1 votes and no recent candidates. Voting no change topics="elchain" WRN 2025-04-29 13:16:36.057+00:00 Eth1 deposits not available. Skipping block proposal topics="beacval" slot=6228 NTC 2025-04-29 13:16:36.057+00:00 Engine block building error topics="beacval" slot=6228 head=a4be69ea:6226 validator=997c460d err="Eth1 deposits not available" ``` cc <@654267572107083777> this doesn't seem to break teku/lodestar/lighthouse still investigating why there is different behaviour from different clients well it didn't cause a fork, so thats good we are still finalizing well, just missing a lot of proposals 🤔 was this deposit before or after Pectra fork? yeah its just block biulding after just made it like an hour ago still waiting for inclusion deposit: https://assertoor.pectra-msf-1.ethpandaops.io/run/8 How can we redeploy custom branch? <@777935002263617576> trigger a builder, and let me know when you got a new image so we need to publish new docker image? yes. so can't just use {optional:repository} {optional:ref} to make your script to build the image? yes you can you don't need to build an image you just reference your branch we as in ethpandaops have to publish a new docker image thats the image builder to trigger the builder `/build trigger grandine https://repo commit_hash` should do the trick? you can trigger from this server from any channel `/build client-cl client:grandine ...` you can do /build and it wil bring up the helper. <@412614104222531604> I'm wondering how does this command know that this image needs to be deployed to the msf-1 network? it doesn't thats still wip i'll be rolling it out oh ok, so I need to tell you after the image is built? yeah can you redeploy to all grandine pairs on msf-1? rolling Is there any update on the missed proposals on msf ? if it's prysm issue then we discussed here. Non issue: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1366516735469031654/1366664978731368460 Please redeploy all grandine instances on msf-1, thanks it's nimbus and grandine from what I can tell right now in the explorer all nimbus nodes + all X-erigon nodes are also missing blocks now. The erigon issue makes sense assuming that all erigon nodes being run are full nodes that don't store all the deposit logs with which image? You don’t see a new build in your system? i can look it up😅 updated I’m wondering is there any chance to reproduce this issue in an isolated environment such as test vectors? This would be way easier to debug it. CC: <@592004585506340885> I don't fully understand what the issue is. There's a disagreement on `state.eth1_deposit_index`? I'm not sure if it would be easy to reproduce with a test vector. I would suggest double checking that these electra updates are made: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/85e6451072531b6bc00a66e301f0636711f2886c/specs/electra/validator.md#deposits I don't believe there are tests for these btw. So it could have gone under the radar. We are still debugging it, but the issue started with https://dora.pectra-msf-1.ethpandaops.io/slot/5498 . With this block deposit count went from 0 to 2032963. Hmm yes it did. That's a little fishy. At slot [5501](https://dora.pectra-msf-1.ethpandaops.io/slot/5501) the deposit count is 0 again. And it flips a few times after then. Doesn’t make much sense to me Would be nice if somebody on later time zone investigates it while we sleep 😄 It appears that every block with erigon sets the deposit count to 0. This happens in earlier slots too. At slot [5482](https://dora.pectra-msf-1.ethpandaops.io/slot/5482), the deposit count is 14 😅 Ok, but deposit count can’t keep flipping in such way well, given at slot 1 it was 0, then going to over 2 million in a few k slots is not really plausible cc <@&688101493978562687> we know Idk why i tagged the guy I think it was because those nodes were badly initilized Also sorry if i ask but eth1data should be deprecated post-pectra essentially is that the first time it changed? I checked the first epoch and all blocks had 0 count we were discussing it here https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1366516735469031654 the issue is that erigon nodes were run as full nodes which didn't store history. So pre pectra activation, when the CL requested for deposit logs, it returned empty responses. So all erigon nodes created a deposit tree with 0 deposits and non-erigon nodes created a deposit tree with mainnet deposits. That's the main disagreement here. Ah thanks. I didn't know that thread existed! we unfortunately won't see any new deposit in the msf network soon. I think everything works as expected. We're using the mainnet deposit contract, so the beacon chain started processing the 1.7M deposits from mainnet after the first voting period. These deposits are all invalid for the msf due to the different fork version, but processing is still limited to 16 deposits per slot. So it'll take >106k slots (14 days) to process all the "invalid" mainnet deposits before we can sea any valid testing deposit :/ yeah that seems right unfortunately :/ we should use a different deposit contract for future mainnet shadow forks we used to, we switched to using everything the same as mainnet after the holesky debacle -.- sounds like msf2 tomorrow I dont think there's a need, right? most of what's being discussed is not a mainnet thing, its definitely scoped to msfs. The time we decide to use the same contract address and now it backfires 😅 Second time actually, we had the same "bug" during the merge testing when we had to rapidly process all the deposits and no client was able to do so. My assumption was that with eip-6110 we wouldn't have that issue anymore, but i was clearly wrong😅 How does everyone feel about a msf2 with a different deposit contract? or do we just shut down msf1 once the withdrawals have processed and call it a day? depends what our goal was from MSF1? if we haven't got the info we need then it might be prudent? The goal was to test mainnet client releases and make sure we aren't missing something we'd regret in a week, imo its more of a sanity check at this point Just an idea, can you fast forward the system time on the containers that are running the nodes for shadow-fork? Then we will know the real future unfortunately not that easily :/ the best we could do is msf2 tomorrow with a new deposit contract that has no deposits on it so if we have a new deposit contract then we'd not be seeing deposits onto the SF anyway so maybe it adds no value unless we're inserting them ourselves? Well we'd add deposits ourselves once the shadowfork is live, we can't have deposits earlier as we'd be burning 32eth on mainnet if we do that 'different deposit contract' has plagued us is all so really imo maybe not adding much value at this point for a ton of work that its likely to be sounds good! are we fine to sunset msf1 in that case? we can still hold off for opinions on msf2 till tomorrow and spin one up if requested! even if any client team has a tiny feeling that it's good to have msf2, we'll do it imo i'd sunset it but who were the main ppl looking? <@976542403269910539> <@491624610215886849> <@363800010518822915> No objections i'm fine too. but can you hold off for a couple hours? will check internally if anyone in the team wants to have a look No objection. I dont think anyone from our team is looking Paul from teku team. 🤣 so helpful... besu's contract addy is configurable via genesis file, idk if that helps another msf

we were discussing it here https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1366516735469031654
the issue is that erigon nodes were run as full nodes which didn't store history. So pre pectra activation, when the CL requested for deposit logs, it returned empty responses. 
So all erigon nodes created a deposit tree with 0 deposits and non-erigon nodes created a deposit tree with mainnet deposits. That's the main disagreement here.

excerpts.author: pk910
excerpts.content:
we unfortunately won't see any new deposit in the msf network soon.
I think everything works as expected. We're using the mainnet deposit contract, so the beacon chain started processing the 1.7M deposits from mainnet after the first voting period.
These deposits are all invalid for the msf due to the different fork version, but processing is still limited to 16 deposits per slot. 
So it'll take >106k slots (14 days) to process all the "invalid" mainnet deposits before we can sea any valid testing deposit :/
